free_tier.stated: A free tier open to a new account with a verified phone number, when capacity is available; at a zero balance the account continues on the free tier, and paid routes start at USD 0.099 per 1M input tokens.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

chaining: capacity is the scarce link, so a free-tier plan cannot be depended on at a fixed hour

limits.value: free-tier use depends on available capacity

identity_cost.detail: the free tier requires a verified phone number on the account

reliability_note: the free tier is explicitly capacity-gated, so a request can be refused while the account is in good standing

evidence.proved: a phone-verified account can use the free tier when capacity is available, and a zero balance falls back to it
evidence.quote: - **Free tier.** A new account with a verified phone number can use the free tier, when capacity is available.
